name: codeplans
description: Connect Claude Code to CodePlans and work with its planning record: model a repo, load context before a change, log work, manage specs, close plans and ship releases.

api_url.title: CodePlans URL
api_url.description: Base URL of your CodePlans instance, without a trailing slash (for example https://acme.codeplans.app or http://localhost:3000)

api_key.title: CodePlans API key
api_key.description: An API key from Settings → API Keys in CodePlans (starts with cpk_). Use a read/write key to let skills make changes.
